stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, plus first steps in computational thinking and Python, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading and writing, the sciences and history, plus programming in Python and how computers and the internet work.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through calculus and statistics, the lab sciences, English and history, plus Python with data and algorithms, and object-oriented programming.

stages.name: College computer science
stages.blurb: The core of a computer science degree: programming, discrete math, tools, data structures, algorithms, systems, networks, databases, theory, languages, software engineering, the mathematics of computing, security, AI, machine learning, the web and distributed systems.

stages.name: Software engineering career
stages.blurb: Testing and code quality, design and architecture, system design, interview preparation, a shipped capstone project, and professional practice.
